In Brief
Man Sells Striker, Repurchases Him Forty Minutes Later. A
manager at the transfer desk disposed of Yoane Wissa and then
reacquired the same footballer inside a single window, describing
the round trip as a liquidity manoeuvre. The exercise altered
nothing and cost four points.
Sixteen Of Twenty-One Clubs Own Footballer Who Did Not
Play. João Pedro was held by sixteen squads in Gameweek 5 and
recorded zero minutes for all of them. Three managers started him
anyway and four appointed him captain.
Reserve Outscores Starter At Sixteen Of Twenty-One Clubs. In
seventy-six percent of this division, a substitute finished the
weekend ahead of at least one player selected to start. No club
has issued a statement.
Manager Who Joined Two Gameweeks Late Beats Four Who
Did Not. BruceBall, which entered the competition at Gameweek
3, returned a stronger weekly world rank than four clubs present
since August. The club declined to celebrate, citing the hard
yards.
CORRECT IONS
A previous edition described Alex Palmer as a mid fielder of
consequence. He is a reserve goalkeeper at Ipswich and did not
leave the bench.
This newspaper reported that Riccardo Cala fiori scored from twenty-
five yards. He did not. He returned one point and the sentence has
been withdrawn.
We stated that a Bench Boost returned nothing. It returned ten, all of
it from Matheus Cunha. The remaining three substitutes returned
nothing, which is a di fferent sentence.
